title: Kestrel Care Rewards Level Qualification and Year-Start Level Review
content:
The level of a **Kestrel Care Rewards** membership is set by qualifying spend for the four free levels, and by payment of a fee for the two Plus levels. This rulebook entry states how a level is reached, kept and reset.

## Rules

**R1 — Starting level and age.** A new free membership starts at Kestrel Care Rewards Member. To enroll, the patient must be at least the minimum age in whole years shown in the schedule below.

**R2 — Qualifying spend.** Qualifying spend is measured over the tier year shown for the level; for the free levels the tier year is the calendar year, 1 January to 31 December. Qualifying spend is the total eligible spend of the front-store purchases that earned points in the tier year, less the spend of any of those purchases whose points were reversed. Prescription purchases never count toward qualifying spend.

**R3 — Moving up during the year.** A free membership moves up to the highest free level whose qualifying-spend threshold is met by the qualifying spend, on the day it is met.

**R4 — Year-start review.** At the start of a tier year the level is kept for the number of calendar months shown as the hold period, and then set to the highest free level that the **previous** tier year's qualifying spend met.

**R5 — Plus levels.** A patient joins Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly or Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual by paying its fee, which moves the membership to that level whatever its spend. Leaving Plus returns the membership to the free level that its current qualifying spend meets.

## Level schedule

| Level | Minimum age to enroll | Tier year | Qualifying spend threshold (USD) | Hold period after the tier year ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 18 years | calendar year | 0.00 | 0 months |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 18 years | calendar year | 250.00 | 2 months |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 18 years | calendar year | 750.00 | 2 months |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 18 years | calendar year | 1500.00 | 2 months |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 18 years | not applicable | 0.00 (joined by fee) | 0 months |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 18 years | not applicable | 0.00 (joined by fee) | 0 months |

A threshold is met when the qualifying spend reaches it: spend of exactly 750.00 meets the Kestrel Care Rewards Gold threshold, and spend of 749.99 does not.

## Worked through (hypothetical member, hypothetical figures)

*Moving up.* A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Member has 240.00 of qualifying spend in the current calendar year. A front-store purchase with 30.00 of eligible spend earns points on 14 April, bringing qualifying spend to 270.00. The highest free level whose threshold 270.00 meets is Kestrel Care Rewards Silver (250.00 met; 750.00 not met), so the membership moves to Silver on 14 April.

*Prescription spend.* In the same year the member also pays 400.00 for prescriptions. Qualifying spend stays at 270.00, because prescription purchases never count.

*Year-start review, level confirmed.* A member ended the previous calendar year at Kestrel Care Rewards Gold with 800.00 of qualifying spend. On 1 January the level is kept for 2 months; it is then set to the highest free level that 800.00 meets, which is Kestrel Care Rewards Gold.

*Year-start review, level set lower.* A member held Kestrel Care Rewards Gold throughout the previous calendar year but ended it with 400.00 of qualifying spend. The level is kept for the 2-month hold period and then set to the highest free level that 400.00 meets: Kestrel Care Rewards Silver.

*Leaving Plus.* A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual leaves Plus when the current calendar year's qualifying spend stands at 900.00. The membership returns to the free level that 900.00 meets: Kestrel Care Rewards Gold.

## Points of judgement

- **Does a Plus member need qualifying spend?** No. Paying the Plus fee moves the membership to that Plus level whatever its spend.
- **Which year's spend decides the level set after the hold period?** The previous tier year's qualifying spend.
- **Does a returned purchase still count?** Spend on a purchase whose points were reversed is taken out of qualifying spend.
